company: 和路雪中国 (The Magnum Ice Cream Company)
responsibilities: Semantic Modeling & Governance: Architect and maintain a scalable semantic layer using dbt, ensuring that business definitions, logic, and metrics are consistent and standardized across the global organization.

BI Architecture & Optimization: Design, deploy, and manage enterprise-grade datasets and workspaces within Power BI Premium Capacity. Optimize DAX queries, data models, and refresh schedules for maximum performance and cost efficiency.
Build & Implement: Take a hands-on role in implementing data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration workflows using tools like Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake), dbt, and Fivetran
Promote Best Practices: Apply and champion our standards for data modeling, ELT patterns, CI/CD, data testing, and observability within a modern DevOps culture

Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with data scientists, engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver cohesive solutions. Provide technical guidance and support to other engineers on the team
